items.heading: Mohinga
details: Key ingredients: rice noodles, fish, banana stem, lemongrass
Simmer catfish with lemongrass and aromatics into a fragrant broth.
Thicken the broth with a little rice flour or chickpea flour.
Add sliced banana stem for texture.
Ladle the hot broth over rice noodles and top with crispy fritters.

items.heading: Lahpet Thoke
details: Key ingredients: fermented tea leaves, peanuts, cabbage, tomato
Toss fermented tea leaves with a little oil.
Add fried peanuts, beans and sesame seeds.
Mix in shredded cabbage and diced tomato.
Toss everything with lime juice and a splash of fish sauce before serving.

items.heading: Shan Noodles
details: Ingredients: noodles/pasta, vegetables or protein, aromatics, sauce and oil.
